memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: initial assessment of right knee osteoarthritis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 46‑year‑old lab technician reports dull aching pain in both knees worsening after prolonged standing at work, no swelling or locking.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 27.0 (obese). Knees show mild crepitus, full range of motion, no effusion. No erythema.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis of both knees, obese. Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2 borderline), LDL 3.4 mmol/L (<2.6 high), HDL 1.2 mmol/L (>1.0 OK), triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7 borderline). Fasting blood sugar 98 mg/dL (<100 normal). Vitamin D level pending.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium carbonate 500 mg with vitamin D3 400 IU OD. Advise weight reduction, low‑impact exercise, quadriceps strengthening. Return if: worsening pain, knee swelling, fever >39°C, inability to bear weight.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-15 at 10:30 am with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of knee osteoarthritis and vitamin D deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports knee pain unchanged, occasional paracetamol use, no new swelling.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 26.6 (obese). Knees tender on medial joint line, crepitus present, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, obese, vitamin D deficiency. Advised on diet and activity due to BMI ≥23.
ARRANGEMENTS: Change paracetamol to 500 mg TDS SOS, continue topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium 500 mg + vitamin D3 400 IU OD, add cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD to replete vitamin D. Advise weight loss target 5 kg, swimming twice weekly. Return if: worsening pain, knee swelling with redness, fever >39°C, night pain disturbing sleep.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: Joint space narrowing medial compartment bilaterally, mild osteophytes, no subchondral cyst or fracture. Consistent with moderate osteoarthritis.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘My right knee has been hurting more when I climb stairs; I’ve been taking paracetamol three times a day but it only helps a little.’

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review, influenza vaccine offered.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports increased knee pain on stairs, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 129/83 mmHg, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.2 (overweight). Knees painful on passive flexion, mild crepitus, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, overweight. Vitamin D level to be rechecked. Advised on diet and activity due to BMI ≥23.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current analgesics, advise physiotherapy referral. Influenza vaccine offered and given today 2025‑10‑20. Return if: severe knee pain preventing weight bearing, swelling with warmth, fever >39°C, signs of infection.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: winter check‑up, assess response to therapy.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient says knee pain slightly better with regular paracetamol, still uses topical gel.
EXAMINATION: BP 127/81 mmHg, weight 75 kg, BMI 25.9 (overweight). Knees mildly tender, full ROM, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, overweight. Vitamin D repleted? Labs pending.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, repeat serum vitamin D. Continue paracetamol 500 mg TDS SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium 500 mg + vitamin D3 400 IU OD, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Advise maintain activity, avoid prolonged kneeling. Return if: worsening pain, knee swelling, fever >39°C, night sweats.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 4.9 mmol/L (ref <5.2), LDL 2.9 mmol/L (ref <2.6), HDL 1.3 mmol/L (ref >1.0), Triglycerides 1.6 mmol/L (ref <1.7). Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL (ref 70‑99). Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 28 ng/mL (ref 30‑100) – still slightly low.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: spring follow‑up, review labs and symptoms.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports knee pain unchanged, occasional paracetamol use.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 74 kg, BMI 25.5 (overweight). Knees mildly tender, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, overweight. Fasting lipids improved, vitamin D still suboptimal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase vitamin D3 to cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD, continue other meds. Advise weight reduction goal 2 kg, low‑impact aerobic exercise. Return if: worsening pain, knee swelling with redness, fever >39°C, inability to climb stairs.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: mid‑year review of osteoarthritis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient states knee pain stable, able to walk 3 km without discomfort.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 73 kg, BMI 25.2 (overweight). Knees mildly tender on medial side, full ROM, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, overweight. Vitamin D adequate.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen, reinforce quadriceps strengthening. Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees scheduled today. Return if: sudden increase in pain, locking of knee, swelling with warmth, fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: Joint space narrowing unchanged from prior film, mild osteophytes, no new lesions. Stable osteoarthritis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review, influenza vaccine offered.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional knee ache after long standing, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 129/81 mmHg, weight 72 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight, just below obese cut‑off). Knees mildly tender, no effusion.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knees, overweight. Lipids and sugars within target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue paracetamol 500 mg TDS SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium 500 mg + vitamin D3 400 IU OD, cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD. Influenza vaccine given today 2026‑10‑05. Advise maintain weight, continue exercises. Return if: worsening pain, knee swelling, fever >39°C, night pain disturbing sleep.
